body: ROLLBACK HOLD (Fable2 #5769, 2026-11-12 21:26Z), in force until BOTH coordinators (Fable2 and Engram::Fable) send "rollback hold ended" (review about 09:00Z on 2026-11-13). The AACB rollback scripts refuse unless the installed Engram binary is exactly the old or the cutover build: Central C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe d4d0182b (old) or b2fc71a9 (cutover); DL560 /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram 0c7d8988 (old) or 5b5ac67e (cutover). So NOTHING installs or replaces the installed engram binary on any host. The Engram Merger lands and pushes w-34e0 and w-5f56 but does not install them. TermAl landings and termal.exe installs are unaffected. s4, Codex 6/7 and the Mac lanes are bound by it too.
